text: marie: Hey team, CI is failing for the mkdocs site on the i18n redirect tests and a couple of image-caption anchors. Saw it in the nightly build logs. alex: ugh, saw that too. failing step is `mkdocs build` during the linkcheck phase. error shows 404 for `/en-GB/guide/#screenshot-caption` even though the caption is present in source. sam: can you paste the exact error snippet? I ran locally and couldn't reproduce initially. marie: here's the failing lines from CI: ``` ERROR: Fragment not found: /en-GB/guide/#screenshot-caption ERROR: Internal redirect: /guide/ -> /en-GB/guide/ (redirected to same page) ``` priya: that second one smells like our locale redirect plugin double-appending locale when base url ends with a slash. I fixed something similar during the migration. alex: oh yeah — we changed site_url and base_dir in mkdocs.yml recently. maybe the plugin expects no trailing slash. sam: quick test: in my local mkdocs, removing the trailing slash from site_url made the i18n redirect resolve correctly. but the image caption fragment still 404s. marie: the caption anchor is autogenerated by the markdown extension. The file has: `![Screenshot](img/s.png){#screenshot-caption}` and mkdocs builds a caption id `screenshot-caption` but linkcheck sees `screenshot-caption-1` sometimes. Could be a duplicate-id dedupe behavior. priya: interesting — maybe when the same image is included twice across locales the slug gets deduped with `-1`. Linkcheck references the canonical path without the suffix. docs-ci-bot: nightly/docs-build failed (https://ci.redwood.ai/build/8792) :x: | failing job: docs-linkcheck | duration: 12m alex: I pushed a tiny repro branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1379 — adds two pages with same caption across en and en-GB. Can someone try running `mkdocs build` with `mkdocs-redirects` and `mkdocs-i18n` enabled? sam: checking out PR now. Will run: `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && mkdocs build --clean` and report back. (small pause) sam: local run reproduced both issues. Quick hack: adding an explicit anchor on the first occurrence fixes linkcheck: `### Screenshot ` but that's ugly. marie: thanks. We should either fix the slugify/dedupe behavior in the docs preprocessing or adjust linkcheck to allow deduped anchors. Pref preference: fix generator so ids are stable across locales. priya: I can try a patch: if the id dedupe adds `-1`, record canonical id mapping and emit a redirect fragment file that maps `#screenshot-caption` -> `#screenshot-caption-1` during build. It's a bit of a hack but less invasive. alex: alternative is a small docs lint rule rejecting duplicate caption ids across translated pages. Then authors add explicit anchors or vary captions. Pro: simpler, catches issues earlier. Con: more manual work for writers. marie: for immediate unblock, let's patch the linkcheck to accept deduped variants and add a short-term lint rule ticket. Priya, do you want to open the PR for the linkcheck relax? Sam can add the lint ticket. priya: yep, I'll open a PR against the docs build tooling with tests. PR link incoming. sam: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/412 — "lint: detect duplicated auto-generated anchors across locales" marie: thanks. Also, can we add a short note in the contributor guide about explicit image anchors for complex layouts? People keep reusing the same screenshot filenames. alex: will add a one-paragraph note and a snippet for explicit anchor markup in docs/contributing.md in the same PR as the linkcheck tweak. docs-ci-bot: PR 1379 triggered new build: docs-linkcheck (pending) marie: nice. once the linkcheck tweak lands, we can rerun nightly. If CI still flags anything, we'll schedule a short docs office-hour to triage. :calendar: sam: good plan. I'll follow up with a small script to find repeated image filenames across locale directories — that'll help prevent accidental duplicate ids. marie: perfect. thanks everyone — loop me in the PRs and I'll coordinate merge window to avoid breaking the current release train. :thumbsup:
